question: What is Cryptbrew?
answer: Cryptbrew is business Bitcoin invoicing and tax-ready payment tracking for small and medium businesses. Merchants create invoices, accept Bitcoin (Lightning and on-chain), and get records suitable for bookkeeping and taxes.

question: What are Cryptbrew fees?
answer: Cryptbrew (the Bitcoin invoicing product) charges a 1% fee with a minimum of 10 sats per payment. The iOS app is free. CryptBrew Lock is a separate Mac app with its own price — not this fee.

question: Is there an iOS app?
answer: Yes. The Cryptbrew iOS app is free on the App Store (id 6776077464). It is used for business Bitcoin invoicing and payment tracking.

question: Does Cryptbrew hold my Bitcoin or private keys?
answer: No. Cryptbrew auto-forwards payments to the merchant's Lightning or on-chain wallet. Merchant private keys are not stored, and Cryptbrew is not long-term custody.

question: How do payments work?
answer: You create an invoice or payment link for your customer. When they pay in Bitcoin (Lightning or on-chain), Cryptbrew tracks the payment for your records and auto-forwards funds to your configured merchant wallet. You keep tax-ready payment history without Cryptbrew holding long-term custody.

question: Can I share a payment link?
answer: Yes. Cryptbrew supports payment links via php.cryptbrew.com/payment-link.php so customers can pay without a complex checkout flow.

question: What is CryptBrew Lock?
answer: CryptBrew Lock is a separate Mac lock-screen product from Cryptbrew LLC (not the Cryptbrew iOS invoicing app). It supports Touch ID and an optional failed-auth photo plus email alert. Notarized, Apple silicon (arm64). Install: brew tap cryptbrew/tap && brew install --cask cryptbrew-lock (tap https://github.com/cryptbrew/homebrew-tap). Price $9.99 after trial.

question: How much does CryptBrew Lock cost?
answer: CryptBrew Lock is $9.99 after the trial. Install with Homebrew: brew tap cryptbrew/tap && brew install --cask cryptbrew-lock (https://github.com/cryptbrew/homebrew-tap). Also on https://www.cryptbrew.com/downloads/.

question: Does Cryptbrew help with taxes?
answer: Cryptbrew provides tax-ready payment tracking for SMBs so Bitcoin invoices and payments are easier to reconcile for bookkeeping and tax reporting.

question: How do I get support?
answer: Email support@cryptbrew.com, visit www.cryptbrew.com/support.html or /help.html, or WhatsApp (707) 387-4140. For setup visits, contact hello@cryptbrew.com.

question: Where is the API documentation?
answer: API docs are at https://api.cryptbrew.com/redoc. Health endpoints include GET /payments/health and GET /health on api.cryptbrew.com.

question: Is there an llms.txt for AI agents?
answer: Yes. Cryptbrew publishes https://www.cryptbrew.com/llms.txt for AI agents and tools that want structured product context.

question: Where can I download Cryptbrew products?
answer: iOS Cryptbrew app: App Store. CryptBrew Lock (Mac): https://www.cryptbrew.com/downloads/ or Homebrew — brew tap cryptbrew/tap && brew install --cask cryptbrew-lock (https://github.com/cryptbrew/homebrew-tap).

question: How do I install CryptBrew Lock with Homebrew?
answer: Use the Cryptbrew org tap (not a personal tap): brew tap cryptbrew/tap && brew install --cask cryptbrew-lock. Requires Apple silicon (arm64), macOS Big Sur+. Tap: https://github.com/cryptbrew/homebrew-tap · Downloads: https://www.cryptbrew.com/downloads/
